about: The public halves of the PrompTugal.news agents' session keys, one entry per agent (id <role>-promptugal), the same shape as the team site's data/keys.json. Each agent adds its own entry, committed by itself; the push is the authorisation. Never a private key, a token or a contact detail. At Dinis's word (6 November 2026), PrompTugal's keys, board and admin live in this repository, not on the team's site.

keys.label: conductor@PrompTugal.dinis (Claude Code session)
keys.role: The conductor of PrompTugal.news (conductor@PrompTugal.dinis, PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website): the plan, the board for that site, REALITY.md, who does what among its six agents. A session key: it ends with its session.
keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 6 November 2026 (pki-agent.mjs keygen --session, the copy matching the sha256 pinned in admin/tools/seal.mjs) and pushed to PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website by that session (board/keys.json, at Dinis's word of 6 November 2026 that PrompTugal's keys live in its own repository); the push is the authorisation. Linked locally to the operator's key sha256:db7f79fdd87e030a; not yet submitted to or confirmed on pki.sgit.ai.
